elevate.move: Make the type carry the cut sheet: one true fractional dimension system site-wide and a display-face cut number set large against the small mono spec on every h2, so the hero's scale contrast runs through the page and a text-only screenshot reads as a joiner's cut list.

Give the scroll a sheet shape: end on a paper footer where the CUT 00-09 labels reassemble into one finished cut list, and let the scarf-joint plate overlap the proof/area tone boundary as the page's one deliberate off-grid moment, replacing the two dead zones.
